bends.note: 60' street (centre about x 6280, R.R. track down its middle) narrows south of the R.R. siding to a 10' passage along its west side (centre x 6210); centreline jogs here

ends.note: printed GARRARD (NOT OPENED); stops at the R.R. sidings of the Mill Creek yard

notes: Sheet is the Mill Creek rail yard west of Valley; Queen City Av (top) and Harrison Av (bottom) cross it. Garrard Av north of the yard is printed 'not opened' and ends at the sidings; a separate 30' Garrard Av leaves Harrison southward at the bottom (labelled on this sheet). Valley lies on the binding gutter (east edge off the page): Queen City/Valley centre estimated from the west edge plus the street track, page curl compresses x there, so treat it as less precise. South of the siding Valley is only a 10' passage (lots 2201/2200 face it) reaching Harrison; Western Av leaves Harrison southward just west of it (both curbs visible, east one in the gutter).
